about: Script-only cases for check_evidence.py 0.3.0. Written on 2026-11-13, before the script was changed; every label was fixed when the case was written. kind: correct = a true claim with its right quote (should pass); wrong = a claim with a changed number (must be flagged); limit = a true claim with a number the document does not state (flagged on purpose: the script does not do arithmetic, rounding or counting).
